description: Implement a function that validates and returns a transaction amount. An amount of zero or greater is returned unchanged. A negative amount must raise a ValueError.
test_code:
import pytest
from main import set_transaction_amount

test_cases = [
    (100, 100),
    (250, 250),
]

validation_cases = [
    pytest.param(0, 0, marks=pytest.mark.validate),
    pytest.param(9999, 9999, marks=pytest.mark.validate),
]

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input1", "expected_output"), test_cases + validation_cases
)
def test_set_transaction_amount(input1, expected_output):
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: {input1}")
    result = set_transaction_amount(input1)
    print(f"Expected: {expected_output}")
    print(f"Actual:   {result}")
    assert result == expected_output


def test_set_transaction_amount_negative_raises_value_error():
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: -1")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        set_transaction_amount(-1)
    print(f"Expected: ValueError")
    print(f"Actual:   ValueError")
